features.title: Review project and workspace changes by scope
features.summary: Choose a registered project or an existing JJ thread workspace from the shared searchable picker, recover from a missing workspace by choosing another folder, and optionally set a base bookmark; read its jj diff (or, in a git-only repository, its git diff from the merge base with the bookmark, uncommitted and untracked files included), group changed files with pulls.review's deterministic rules, and show every scope's diff in one scrollable review with progress kept in diff-viewed's one viewed-marks store. The same grouping is available as the /pulls command in a thread and the pulls_review agent tool. The page stays the cross-project view; Open in thread opens the thread's Changes facet.
failureModes: A missing workspace, a workspace without a jj repository, no resolvable base bookmark, or a missing jj binary is reported with its own reason instead of an empty diff.
jj stderr never reaches the client; a failed command is classified, not quoted.
A patch larger than the Host cap, or one with more files than one message carries, is flagged as truncated and clipped rather than silently shortened or rejected.
In a git-only repository the same reasons apply with git wording; a saved range holds commit ids, and a revision that would read as a git option is refused as a missing base.
A git read failure names the commands to see the error in the thread folder (git status, git diff <base>) and says to refresh the review once it is fixed.

externalDependencies.boundary: The jj CLI in the resolved thread workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The e2e journey provisions a disposable jj repository; unit tests inject a scripted jj runner and check the real CLI output separately.

externalDependencies.boundary: The git CLI through @dshfiles/git-cli in a git-only thread workspace; a live review snapshots the worktree into a throwaway index, never the real one.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary git repositories and worktrees in tests/git-output.spec.ts; no git mock is used.

features.title: Summarize review scopes with the thread's own model
features.summary: One model call over the whole diff turns the deterministic scope summaries into short one-line-per-scope prose, using the provider the thread last requested with and the first model that provider offers.
failureModes: No thread provider, no offered model, or no Host llm service is reported as its own reason, never as an empty summary.
A review that failed, or a workspace with no changes, keeps its own reason instead of blaming the model.
An answer without a usable `key: text` line leaves the deterministic summaries in place.
An explicit provider/model from the caller wins over the thread route.

externalDependencies.boundary: The DSH llm service and the provider route the thread's session log records.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Unit tests inject a scripted complete() and route sources; the scratch profile has no provider, so its UI path can only be reached with a configured account.

verification.reason: A *successful* summary needs a configured provider account and the scratch/e2e profiles have none, so no browser journey can drive one. The failure footer is asserted by the catalog reach, and the route, protocol and failure paths by unit tests.

features.title: Mark a selection of changed files reviewed
features.summary: The review-wide selector covers files across every scope; per-file checkboxes can still extend or toggle the selection, and one action marks or clears it in the review progress the Host keeps for every browser. A plain click on Mark reviewed still toggles that file.
failureModes: A mark only ever covers paths in the current review, so changing the workspace or revision prunes ids the diff no longer lists.
The selection is presentation state and never touches the stored reviewed marks until the batch action runs.

verification.testName: marks and unmarks a batch without duplicating or dropping other paths

features.title: Review a thread's changes in its Changes facet
features.summary: A thread panel tab that follows the thread on screen and shows its changes in four scopes (this turn from DSH's own turn snapshot; whole thread from fork_point(bookmark | @); uncommitted @-..@; vs the target bookmark), with a file list, one diff view and per-file viewed marks kept in diff-viewed's one store. The jujutsu composer bar, the Land destination rows and the Review page open it through the Changes contract.
failureModes: A workspace that is not a Jujutsu repository says that revision scopes need one and keeps This turn working.
A turn whose summary the Host no longer holds says so and offers a retry instead of an empty list.
A viewed mark that cannot be saved is rolled back and reported.

externalDependencies.boundary: The jj CLI in the thread workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The scratch seed and the e2e journey provision a disposable jj repository with a described revision.

features.title: Read package.json dependency changes as a table
features.summary: In the Changes facet, the combined revisions review and the Review page, a changed package.json shows its added, removed and updated dependencies as a table (package and section, previous, new, change) that replaces the file text diff; Show text diff puts the lines back. A row whose section the diff never names keeps the text on screen, and other changed lines are counted so the table hides nothing.
failureModes: A dependency row the parser cannot place in a named section keeps the file text diff on screen with a note, instead of hiding real edits behind a wrong table.
reach: expect text "Every change since this thread left*"

features.title: Review several selected revisions together
features.summary: Revisions selected in the graph open as one combined review: every revision listed oldest first with its own files, one revision's diff on screen with Previous and Next, a viewed mark per file of each revision, and line comments that name their revision. Each revision stays its own change because jj cannot diff across a gap, so a selection with gaps says so. In a thread that owns the repository it is the Revisions scope of the Changes facet; otherwise it opens on the Review page. The pulls_review_revisions agent tool reads the same review.
failureModes: A selection with gaps says that revisions between them are not part of the review.
A revision that is gone or divergent is named and left out, and the rest is still reviewed; a divergent row is selected from the graph by its commit.
A review too large for one read flags which revisions are partial and says to select fewer.
A git-only repository is refused with the reason instead of an empty review.

externalDependencies.boundary: The jj CLI in the selected repository.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Host tests and the e2e journey build a disposable jj repository with stacked, gapped and divergent revisions.

features.title: A turn's Edited files card opens Changes on that turn
features.summary: Claims the native per-turn review address (dsh-resource://changes-review/…) at the extension band, so the Edited N files card and its review button open the one Changes facet scoped to that turn instead of a second review tab; the viewed marks are the same per-turn marks the native review tab writes.
failureModes: An address that is not a turn review is not claimed, so the native tab keeps every other resource.

verification.testName: reads the turn card address the native review tab would open

telemetry.reason: Client-only resource claim; the turn summary and diff are read through native Host routes with their own spans.

features.title: Land a thread from the top of its Changes facet
features.summary: The Land card shows the target bookmark, how far the workspace is behind it, conflicts, undescribed revisions and the thread's project-check receipts, and offers one primary Land that previews the exact revisions in a confirm dialog and calls jj-integration's land with every Host guard; a busy thread offers Land when idle (queueLand, undoable), and History opens the revision graph for rebase-only or describe work.
failureModes: Land is disabled with the reason when revisions conflict, lack a description or the thread is busy; the Host re-checks every guard on click.
A refused or failed land shows jj-integration's reason and leaves the bookmark in place.

externalDependencies.boundary: The jj CLI in the thread workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The scratch seed and the e2e journey provision a disposable jj repository with a described revision.

features.title: Comment on diff lines as chips in the next message
features.summary: Selecting line numbers in a Changes diff opens a comment box; Add to next message queues the comment as a line-comment chip in the thread's composer through the public Composer contract (rich-composer serializes it as <comment path lines>).
failureModes: Without a composer on screen the comment stays in the box with a hint to open the thread and add it again.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the comment goes into the composer draft and is sent with the next message's own spans.

features.title: Move the Review page's marks into the one viewed-marks store
features.summary: On load, the Review page's earlier reviewed record (workspace, base, head → paths) is written into diff-viewed's store as revision-range marks in batches, then emptied; a failed write keeps the record for the next load.
failureModes: A malformed old key is skipped; diff-viewed being unavailable leaves the record untouched.

verification.testName: turns the old reviewed record into diff-viewed range targets

verification.reason: A one-time move on load with no UI of its own; the Review page journey reads marks from the new store.
